parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundDark` (line 30 in `BackgroundGradient.swift`) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundDark` (line 31 in `WXYCGradient.swift`) are exact-duplicate computed properties within the same `WXUI` package. Because the query is `function-duplicates-exact` and neither record carries any restraint flag (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a shared protocol (e.g., `WXYCBackgroundStyle`) with a default implementation of `wxycBackgroundDark` in a protocol extension, then have both `WXYCBackground` and `WXYCGradient` conform to it, eliminating the per-type copies.
